ELECTRICITY — TERMLY EXAM #1
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: ELECTRICITY
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Run with the tool
   B. Work alone with eyes closed
   C. Remove all guards
   D. Wear safety gear and follow instructions

2. When learning Introduction to Electricity, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to Electricity.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Electricity.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to Electricity.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to Electricity.

3. When learning Capacitors and Capacitance 1.5 Pictorial Drawings 2.0 Electrical Machines 2.1 Ma, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Capacitors and Capacitance 1.5 Pictorial Drawings 2.0 Electrical Machines 2.1 Ma.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Capacitors and Capacitance 1.5 Pictorial Drawings 2.0 Electrical Machines 2.1 Ma.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Capacitors and Capacitance 1.5 Pictorial Drawings 2.0 Electrical Machines 2.1 Ma.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Capacitors and Capacitance 1.5 Pictorial Drawings 2.0 Electrical Machines 2.1 Ma.

4. When learning D.C Electric Circuits 1.3 Cells and Batteries 1.4 Capacitors and Capacitance 1.5, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for D.C Electric Circuits 1.3 Cells and Batteries 1.4 Capacitors and Capacitance 1.5.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after D.C Electric Circuits 1.3 Cells and Batteries 1.4 Capacitors and Capacitance 1.5.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for D.C Electric Circuits 1.3 Cells and Batteries 1.4 Capacitors and Capacitance 1.5.
   D. Skip safety briefings for D.C Electric Circuits 1.3 Cells and Batteries 1.4 Capacitors and Capacitance 1.5.

5. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Keyboard
   B. CPU
   C. Monitor
   D. Speaker

6. When learning D.C Electric Circuits, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after D.C Electric Circuits.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for D.C Electric Circuits.
   C. Skip safety briefings for D.C Electric Circuits.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for D.C Electric Circuits.

7. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. International Cricket Team
   B. Internal Cooking Timer
   C. Information and Communication Technology
   D. Input Cable Tester

8. When learning Pictorial Drawings 2.0 Electrical Machines 2.1 Magnetism 2.2 Electromagnetism 2., the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Pictorial Drawings 2.0 Electrical Machines 2.1 Magnetism 2.2 Electromagnetism 2..
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Pictorial Drawings 2.0 Electrical Machines 2.1 Magnetism 2.2 Electromagnetism 2..

   D. Skip safety briefings for Pictorial Drawings 2.0 Electrical Machines 2.1 Magnetism 2.2 Electromagnetism 2..

   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Electro- Magnetism.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Electro- Magnetism.

10. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   B. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   C. Overload every socket
   D. Ignore burnt cables

11. When learning Magnetism, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Cells and Batteries.

14. When learning Inductors and Inductance 3.0 Electrical Installation. 3.1 Generation, Transmissi, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Inductors and Inductance 3.0 Electrical Installation. 3.1 Generation, Transmissi.

   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Pictorial Drawings.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Pictorial Drawings.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Pictorial Drawings.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Capacitors and Capacitance and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Pictorial Drawings 2.0 Electrical Machines 2.1 Magnetism 2.2 Electromagnetism 2. and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
